exposure: tubal ligation at the time of cesarean section
Method of tubal ligation (laparoscopic cauterization vs. Pomeroy technique)
Timing of tubal ligation (during cesarean section or not)
finding: Positive family history, smoking, and oral contraceptive use were associated with early menopause, while older age at first pregnancy and obesity were associated with later menopause; tubal ligation was not found to significantly alter age at menopause.
